title: Attestation quiet notes - Ariel Kim
body:
Purpose: quick capture of control mapping ideas, small evidence naming convention, and a few test-step drafts that I can hand off to Mateo/Priya. Not a finished playbook — fragments, TODOs, and questions.

Topline: we need a minimal, repeatable evidence export flow for auditors + an internal smoke test to prove the pipeline works before each request window. Keep evidence exports small (<200MB) and indexed.

Evidence folder convention (proposal):
- evidence/{control_id}/{YYYYMMDD}/{artifact_type}_{source}_{short-desc}.log or .zip
- example: evidence/CCM-03/2026-03-04/cloudtrail_ec2-terminate-activity.json
- reason: deterministic naming makes sampling + grep trivial for auditor asks

Control mapping notes (rough):
- CC6 (access management): Okta + IAM role inventory + last auth activity. Evidence = OKTA export (users, groups, app assignments), Terraform state (roles), last-login CSV.
- CC7 (change management): GitHub PRs labeled "infra-change" + CI run logs + deploy tag. Evidence = PR bundle (diff, approvals), CI-yyyy-mm-dd.log, deploy-tag.txt
- CCM-03 (logging): CloudTrail + CloudWatch retention policy + S3 lifecycle. Evidence = CloudTrail config screenshot, S3 bucket policy, sample event export

Draft control narrative snippet (access):
"Access to production systems is provisioned via Okta SSO and ephemeral IAM roles managed in Terraform. Requests for access go through the internal access request workflow (Linear TRUST-58) and require manager approval. Onboarding and offboarding are automated by a scheduled reconciliation job that deprovisions roles absent an active assignment."

Open questions / quick TODOs:
- What retention window do auditors expect for infra logs? (I keep seeing 365 vs 545 days) -> ask legal/trust.
- Do we need signed attestations from Dedicated customers to show isolation? OK to show network diagrams + contract copy? (Assign: Priya)
- Can we add a smoke script that: 1) generates a fake login, 2) creates a test PR, 3) runs a small infra deploy to a sandbox, 4) collects artifacts and zips them named per convention? (Assign: Mateo)

Quick grep / fetch commands (for ephemeral use):
- cloudtrail events for user X last 30 days: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=alice@redwood.com --start-time 2026-02-01 --end-time 2026-03-01
- list S3 evidence buckets: aws s3 ls s3://redwood-evidence-*/ --recursive | grep CCM-03
- dump Okta users: okta-cli users export --format csv > okta-users-2026-03-05.csv

Acceptance criteria for a "complete" evidence bundle for a control (example):
- contains metadata.json (creator, timestamp, command/PR link)
- contains raw artifacts (logs, exports) + short narrative.md explaining relevance
- zip size < 250MB (split if larger)

Sample narrative.md (short):
- control: CC6 (access management)
- artifacts: okta-users-2026-03-05.csv, tfstate-roles-2026-03-05.json, last-login.csv
- reason: demonstrates provisioning and last-known authentication for active roles
- sampling instructions: auditor pick any 3 active roles and request log lines for last 30 days

Low-priority ideas:
- small UI in Console to "Produce evidence bundle" for a control id (button that runs the script and uploads to S3)
- retention report (cron) that alerts if any evidence bucket falls below retention policy

Hand-off notes:
- Mateo: prototype smoke script + infra PR for a sandbox deploy (label with TRUST-evidence).
- Priya: check legal on retention window + Dedicated customer attestation requirements.
- Me (Ariel): finalize naming convention + write one example narrative.md for CC6 and CCM-03.

Slack refs: see thread #cs-ops-soc2 on 2026-02-20 for auditor timelines and sample requests.

Random thought: when auditor asks for "all changes to production in Q4 2025" — produce a curated bundle: PRs (merged), deploy tags, deploy pipeline run logs, and runbook snapshot. Keep a small makefile: `make evidence CCM-03` that runs steps for a given control.

Endnotes: keep this doc short. Will move final artifacts to shared_drives/company/misc/trust-evidence once prototype stable.
